benchmark_metadata.dataset_name: Game Accessibility and Gameplay Regression Evaluation
benchmark_metadata.empirical_agent_runs_only: agent_run records with required provenance fields

task_evaluations.interpretation: The feature works and no regression is found.
task_evaluations.evaluation_notes: Single Codex implementation run against a clean upstream revision. The scripted checks cover Normal/Large selection, immediate 30px/24px font overrides, viewport bounds, content-driven minimum sizes, non-overlapping menu rows, in-process instance persistence, and selected gameplay regression paths. This is one task-level run, not a broad or statistically conclusive benchmark.
task_evaluations.environment: Windows; Godot 4.7.2 stable; headless; project viewport 800x480

task_evaluations.interpretation: The feature fails its criteria while baseline checks pass.
task_evaluations.evaluation_notes: Single clean-upstream run. Nine assertions confirm independent volume bus configuration, but actual project contained zero AudioStreamPlayer nodes and no audio assets. Accessibility criterion for distinct audible categories is therefore false; gameplay preserved. Godot exited 0 with full-scene RID/resource warnings.
